citation.title: A cephalometric appraisal of the Chinese

curation.notes: Compared 2026-10-08: norms:compare a vs b exit 1, 19 differences (logs/task9a2-compare-<id>.log). Every mean and SD of both extractors re-read from the page images (PDF pp. 2-6 = journal pp. 20-24), and the settled file checked by script against a third, independent reading of the pages (the table in sets.test.ts). Decisions: (0) Source text normalised to one pattern giving table, page, row and column with sex and age (a and b worded it differently; prose only). Adult rows: a gave [18, 40], b no band -> [18, 40] with the P18 note (merge notes). (1) U1-SN 107 ± 9: b only; Table IV p. 23 prints it in the Chan column -> kept (a put it under Wei). (2) '1/-A Pog mm' 10 ± 2: a #64 / b #63 -> #63 (upper incisor, '1/'), close. (3) Facial axis a same / b close -> close; fix round 1 (8 Oct): -> different, not used (owner FAX-1). Page images: PDF pp. 2-6 = journal pp. 20-24 (Tables I-VI), rendered at 2000 px.

caveats: Quoted second-hand from Moate & Darendeliler 2002 (Aust Orthod J 18:19-26, a compilation of published Chinese cephalometric norms), Table IV; the original paper was not read. The compilation rounds every mean and SD to whole numbers (Lew's soft tissue to 0.5) and gives no landmark, plane or method definitions.
The compilation states no film scale or magnification for any study; assumed true size (owner ruling M-2).
Table IV heads this column 'Chan14', but reference 14 is Cheng 1986; the column was identified by the author name against Moate's reference list (Chan 1972 is reference 15), as both extractors did.
The compilation's text does not describe this study's sample (size, age, selection or place); only its table column and its reference-list entry are given.
Table IV prints Chan in the males columns only.
Table V (p. 24) averages several studies; it is not entered for this study (merge notes).
